python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')

# Shared strings
ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
shared = []
try:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))
except KeyError:
    pass

# Sheet data
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
rows = []
for row in root.findall('.//m:row', ns):
    cells = []
    for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == 's' and val is not None:
            val = shared[int(val)]
        cells.append((ref, t, val))
    rows.append(cells)

for r in rows:
    print(r)
EOF

# ---- budget.xlsx: inject cached calculated values for existing formulas ----
import zipfile, shutil

SRC = 'budget.xlsx'
z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
entries = [(i, z.read(i.filename)) for i in z.infolist()]
z.close()

# Verify sums independently
inc = [5000, 800, 250, 100]
exp = [1500,200,150,350,150,100,500,200,50,100,500,400]
total_income, total_expenses = sum(inc), sum(exp)
balance = total_income - total_expenses
print(f'Total Income  = {total_income}')
print(f'Total Expenses= {total_expenses}')
print(f'Balance       = {balance}')

sheet_xml = None
for info, data in entries:
    if info.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
        sheet_xml = data.decode()

# Inject cached <v> values; keep formulas untouched. Fix off-by-one in B25 (B8-C22 -> B8-C23).
sheet_xml = sheet_xml.replace('<c r="B8" s="3"><f>SUM(B4:B7)</f><v></v></c>',
                              f'<c r="B8" s="3"><f>SUM(B4:B7)</f><v>{total_income}</v></c>')
sheet_xml = sheet_xml.replace('<c r="C23" s="3"><f>SUM(C11:C22)</f><v></v></c>',
                              f'<c r="C23" s="3"><f>SUM(C11:C22)</f><v>{total_expenses}</v></c>')
sheet_xml = sheet_xml.replace('<c r="B25" s="6"><f>B8-C22</f><v></v></c>',
                              f'<c r="B25" s="6"><f>B8-C23</f><v>{balance}</v></c>')

# Rebuild workbook with updated sheet, preserving all other parts
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
    for info, data in entries:
        if info.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            out.writestr(info, sheet_xml)
        else:
            out.writestr(info, data)
print('Updated budget.xlsx (formulas preserved, cached values written)')
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')

# Confirm zip integrity + list parts
bad = z.testzip()
print('Zip integrity OK' if bad is None else f'Corrupt: {bad}')

root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
formula_cells, errors = [], []
for row in root.findall(f'.//{M}row'):
    for c in row.findall(f'{M}c'):
        f = c.find(f'{M}f')
        v = c.find(f'{M}v')
        if f is not None:
            val = v.text if v is not None else ''
            formula_cells.append((c.get('r'), f.text, val))
            if val.startswith('#') or val in ('#REF!', '#DIV/0!', '#VALUE!', '#N/A', '#NAME?'):
                errors.append((c.get('r'), val))

print('\nFormula cells after update:')
for ref, formula, val in formula_cells:
    print(f'  {ref}: ={formula}  -> cached value: {val}')

print(f'\nFormula errors found: {len(errors)} {errors if errors else ""}')

# Verify totals from raw data one more time
exp_vals = []
for row in root.findall(f'.//{M}row'):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        c = row.find(f'{M}c[@r="C{r}"]')
        if c is not None:
            v = c.find(f'{M}v')
            if v is not None: exp_vals.append(float(v.text))
print(f'Expense line items (C11:C22): {exp_vals}')
print(f'Recomputed total expenses: {sum(exp_vals):,.0f}')
EOF
